fullContent:
Rajata Rasayana – Benefits, Usage, Indications and Dosage 
 Reference – Basavarajiyam 
 Introduction 
 Rajata Rasayana is an ayurvedic formulation. This formulation is known to contain effective minerals. These minerals enriched with properties like anti- bacterial, anti-bacterial, anti-inflammatory, immunomodulatory, aphrodisiac, diuretic and many more. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Rajata Bhasma – silver calx 
 Rasa Sindhura – red sulfide of mercury 
 
 Dose 
 10 gram in 40 doses two times a day. 
 Indications 
 
 Spermatorrhea 
 Leucorrhea 
 
 Contraindications 
 Take the medicine under doctor’s prescription 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
